items.title: TCP Use-After-Free: CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in the Linux IPv4 TCP implementation has been identified, rated with a CVSS score of 9.8. Developers and system administrators should prioritize patching this flaw to prevent potential exploitation in networked environments.

items.title: Molly (Signal fork) has not been updated since 3 months and is vulnerable
items.summary: The Molly fork of Signal has not received updates for three months, leaving it vulnerable to security threats. Users and developers should be aware of this lapse and consider alternatives or contributing to its maintenance.

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol can beat Factorio on peaceful mode
items.summary: A new version of the GPT model, GPT-5.6, has demonstrated the ability to outperform the popular game Factorio in peaceful mode. This showcases advancements in AI capabilities and their potential applications in gaming and simulation.

items.title: HackerTube: YouTube built from videos recommended by HN
items.summary: HackerTube is a new platform that curates YouTube videos based on recommendations from Hacker News users. This innovative approach to content discovery could inspire web developers to explore new ways of aggregating and presenting user-generated content.

items.title: Jepsen: ParticleDB 1.1.4
items.summary: The latest analysis from Jepsen on ParticleDB version 1.1.4 reveals important insights into its consistency and fault tolerance. This information is crucial for engineers working with distributed databases and systems architecture.
